snippet.title: Vorynth: Ashfall | Official Gameplay Trailer - Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Vorynth: Ashfall on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5472790/Vorynth_Ashfall/

Plan your turns, hunt for rare loot and shape your build in Vorynth: Ashfall, a dark fantasy RPG. Explore hand-built dungeons, reforge your gear and adventure solo offline or with up to three friends in online co-op.

Developed and published by Dryzor Studios.
Built with Cinderforge Engine, our own C++ engine using SDL2.

Official website: https://vorynthashfall.com/

Development footage. Features and presentation may change.

#VorynthAshfall #TacticalRPG #IndieGame
